selection.worker_support: Binary projection of exactly nine committed shared support sources and their declared nested records; 13 class entries.

projection.owner: Trusted controller CI packaging step; no candidate authorship
projection.input: Existing CI-compiled shared classes from the exact bound service sources. Full service/compiler context stays controller-only.

rewrite_rules.operation: Keep the field and its existing erased List descriptor and constructor initialization. Drop only the field Signature attribute containing SourceEdits$Location.
rewrite_rules.why: Removing the whole field would leave constructor putfield instructions and break ScreenFrame. Generic erasure removes the engine type while preserving JVM field compatibility.

rewrite_rules.operation: Omit this engine adapter method from the worker projection only.
rewrite_rules.why: The method binds directly to SourceEdits.put. Remaining shared record access methods are retained unchanged.

rewrite_rules.operation: Omit only entries whose inner/outer name refers to SourceEdits or SourceEdits$Location; retain all allowed nested-record entries.
rewrite_rules.why: The compiler can retain the generic-only nested type in class metadata even after dropping its field Signature. A fresh constant pool alone does not remove a retained InnerClasses entry.

projection.constant_pool: Re-emit classes into fresh constant pools, not a writer seeded with original constant pools. Reject retained descriptors, signatures, annotation values, method handles, bootstrap arguments or UTF-8 constants naming SourceEdits or excluded classes.
projection.retained_behavior: Preserve every other field, method descriptor and method body from the nine sources. No stubbed business behavior, rewritten algorithm or new Java source.
projection.class_entry_limit: Exact 13-entry allow-list; reject additional class files, nested jars, sources, generated bindings, data, service resources or receipts. Only declared license/provenance text may accompany classes.

projection.linkage: Worker compiles against a subset of the real shared API with identical retained JVM descriptors. Controller evaluation links candidate output against the unchanged complete service; reject candidate class/member references outside the exposed support inventory.

unit_test_strategy.support_runtime: Use the projected utility implementation jar, not an ABI-only all-throwing stub jar. That preserves Commarea, ScreenFrame, record codec and session behavior for factory-authored unit tests.
unit_test_strategy.bindings: Factory tests create their own synthetic six-screen schema/plan objects when Bindings construction is needed. No precomputed service binding output, session answer or expected proof state is copied.
unit_test_strategy.authority: All authorization Java and own tests are authored only by the factory after signed F2; this proposal contains none.

offline_capsule.no_starers: No Spring Boot runtime/starters, application jar, reference engine, current authorization implementation, proof tests or expected data.
offline_capsule.offline_preseed: Resolve only the worker project in a clean controller CI Maven repository. go-offline alone is insufficient acceptance; execute the full worker test lifecycle with networking disabled to discover lazy plugins/providers, then lock each byte.
offline_capsule.retention: Publish binary bundle as Release asset with size/SHA inventory. Commit only manifests and the raw workspace map; no archive or jar in git.
offline_capsule.materialization: Controller validates archive path names and limits, no duplicate entries, traversal, symlink/junction/hardlink, nested archive or unlisted files. Extract regular files only; verify every file SHA/size before any copy or worker creation.
offline_capsule.limits: Existing allow-list caps: each file <=8 MiB, aggregate <=32 MiB, <=4096 files. Fail closed if Maven closure exceeds any limit; do not use compression to evade uncompressed limits.

workspace_revision.retain: The 23 non-Java entries in the original 32-file manifest, including source/BMS/copybooks/DBD/PSB/scope.
workspace_revision.add: Every actual extracted public capsule file as a strict relative path mapped to its real SHA-256; no directory prefix or archive-only hash.
workspace_revision.existing_support: Root .gitignore ignores work/. Explicit _create_allowlisted copies exact regular files listed by read_manifest and does not apply EXCLUDED_NAMES tree-copy filtering. Committed runtime JSON manifests still must match their actual bytes.
workspace_revision.staging_safety: Use only an approved clean CI source_root. Staged ignored public files are hash-bound by the committed workspace map. Ignore status never substitutes for content validation. Never stage private expected bundles here.
workspace_revision.why_not: Capsule bytes do not exist yet; real per-file hashes and retained artifact metadata must be produced by CI. No fake raw manifest with null entries is emitted.
